about: Test window, the test split only: test-break session B's B3, recorded after the freeze (8c7b2f6); no replay, sweep, or tuning on it except the test sweep. A bad_deploy break at 05:51:12 (1.43.0 deployed), left to end with the fault's 390 s lifetime (its rollback recorded at 05:57:43, after the alarm), never cleared by hand, with the alarm rule off: no agent run. The errors alarm alone went into ALARM, at 05:51:46, and was OK at 05:58:06; latency and pool wait never fired. A distractor in the 180-minute log reach: B2, the downstream_timeout break of 04:11:07 (payments-api degraded; latency into ALARM 04:11:48, OK 04:18:08; no deploy record), 100 minutes before the onset. B1, the db_pool_exhaustion break of 02:30:52, is past the log reach, but its pool change and revert (02:30:52, 02:37:23) are in the deploy history. The deploy history shows the 1.43.0 deploy at 05:51:12, decoys RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED false to true at 04:26:26 and at 00:07:15 and LOG_SAMPLE_RATE 0.1 to 0.25 at 00:31:06, B1's records, then session A's, among them two 1.43.0 deploys and rollbacks (A3's at 22:37:51 and 22:44:22, A1's at 19:17:18 and 19:23:49) with the same version and message as this break's. Every deploy record dated before the alarm had been written by then.
